fairness: same permission and visible policy-state hashes for each paired base case; reviewer uses proposer checkpoint

agentdojo.graders: unmodified native utility and security graders

progent.status: additional upstream comparison; never alias stateless baseline to Progent

inference.unit: procedural campaign, paired by base case; repeated variants clustered by base case
inference.interval: distribution-free Hoeffding intervals on independent base-case means; retain all variants
inference.primary_comparisons: complete minus each of four controllers at each of two checkpoints
inference.multiplicity: Bonferroni simultaneous 95% bounds across eight primary comparisons
inference.negative_results: retain failures, missing controllers, unsupported contracts, integration errors and underpowered comparisons

freeze_rule: freeze source, prompts and analysis hashes plus sample size before generating fresh procedural holdouts; do not inspect holdout to tune defenses
capability: parameter counts are checkpoint identifiers, not measured capability
public_model_reference: native graders; upstream Progent generated initial policy via local inference transport; adaptive updates disabled and reported
budget_rule: reserve three measured campaign equivalents per checkpoint for descriptive public reference; total deadline still four GPU-hours
